Program_Info.Program_Change_Info: Discontinued. Standalone sales and downloads ended; unified into Ohnuki-san Hub Pro (https://chililikobo.github.io/en/ohnuki-san-hub.html).

English.Char_Desc_80: [Discontinued] Standalone sales ended. Unified into Ohnuki-san Hub Pro.
English.Char_Desc_250: [Discontinued] Standalone sales and downloads of Ohnuki-san Plus have ended. All features are now unified into Ohnuki-san Hub (Pro Plan): https://chililikobo.github.io/en/ohnuki-san-hub.html
English.Char_Desc_450: [Discontinued] Standalone sales and distribution of Ohnuki-san Plus have ended. Its features have been unified into Ohnuki-san Hub (Pro Plan, with Free Plan & 24h Pro Trial). Note: Legacy Lite/Plus HTML reports are not compatible with Ohnuki-san Hub. Please migrate to Ohnuki-san Hub: https://chililikobo.github.io/en/ohnuki-san-hub.html
English.Char_Desc_2000:
[End of Distribution Notice] New development, standalone sales, and downloads of Ohnuki-san Plus have ended. All features of Ohnuki-san Lite (now Free), Ohnuki-san Plus (now Pro), and Ohnuki-san Dashboard have been unified into the successor application: Ohnuki-san Hub.
Successor Links: - Official Page (EN): https://chililikobo.github.io/en/ohnuki-san-hub.html - Official Page (JP): https://chililikobo.github.io/ohnuki-san-hub.html - Download (GitHub): https://github.com/chililikobo/OhnukisanHub/releases/latest
Compatibility Note: HTML reports generated by legacy Ohnuki-san Lite / Plus cannot be loaded into Ohnuki-san Hub. Please collect new reports using Ohnuki-san Hub.
About Legacy Ohnuki-san Plus: Ohnuki-san Plus was a portable PC system information extractor and diagnostic utility for Windows developed by chilili kobo.
